_doc: Machine-readable quality gates for Python products. Authoritative source consumed by orchestrator/pipelines/post_coder.py's _check_config_gates (Phase 4). Mirrors the human-readable CONFIG GATES table in ARCHITECTURE.md. Lower a value here only with PM approval — do not edit pytest.ini directly to bypass.

addopts.--cov-fail-under.rationale: Python template default. Calculator product showed --cov-fail-under=0 being edited in by agents; this gate prevents that.

addopts.--cov-fail-under.forbidden_value.rationale: Explicit deny of trivially-low coverage thresholds.
